answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 6894 Country: India Title: The namaz offered behind the emam of sunnat al jamat & ahle hadis jamat is kabul bhind them.shall we read the namaz behind them. Question: as salamalakum, The namaz offered behind the emam of sunnat al jamat & ahle hadis jamat is kabul bhind them.shall we read the namaz behind them. Answer ID: 6894 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1730/1336=H/1429) The acceptance of salah depends basically on the relation between a servant and Allah. It is out of place to have a say in the matter. (2) One who is involves in un-Islamic customs or abuses the past Ulama and muqallidin, it is makrooh-e-tahreemi to offer prayer behind him. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
